summary.name: Gitter
summary.one_liner: Gitter is a chat and networking platform for developer and GitHub communities, now built on the Matrix open network.
summary.what_it_does: Gitter is a chat and networking platform aimed at helping communities manage, grow and connect through messaging, content and discovery. Users can sign in with GitHub, GitLab or Twitter and start chatting. Messaging is described as end-to-end encrypted. Messages support Markdown and LaTeX formatting. The page states that Gitter has migrated to Matrix, an open network for decentralized communication that offers a variety of clients.
notable: Built on the Matrix open decentralized network
Sign-in with GitHub, GitLab or Twitter
caveats: Gitter has migrated to Matrix, so the platform's future direction is tied to Matrix
Pricing is not stated on the page
